title: 德莱文·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 后梳深发配卷翘尖胡须，富于表情的眉形保留自信气质。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Draven is an adult Noxian man with dramatically swept dark hair, a pointed curled moustache, expressive eyebrows, and a confident showman's face. Preserve his red-black costume, fur shoulder trim, and silver armor accents with a fully closed shirt, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. His two distinctive crescent-edged axes hang motionless beside the legs, never spinning, raised, or thrown.
art_direction.scene: A gently elevated three-quarter arrangement, the signature motif nearest the viewer, modest accurate perspective and fresh reflected colors. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: vermilion, lilac pencil shadow, gold, pale limestone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
